title: A lattice-based personalized privacy-preserving vertical federated learning system

pse.problem: Data heterogeneity and privacy concerns in traditional processing of collaborative machine learning models
pse.solution_function: A personalized privacy protection longitudinal federal learning system performs distributed training of a joint model without sharing sensitive data directly. Each user updates their local model with the global model, trains it with their local data, and sends encrypted gradients back to the central server for secure aggregation using homomorphic encryption.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of multiple users and a central server. The central server has a global model that undergoes training over many learning cycles. Each user has a local model and a local dataset.
pse.solution_implementation: In one round of learning, the central server provides the global model to all users, who then update their local models with it. Users train their local models using their own data, encrypt gradients using homomorphic encryption, and send them back to the central server for aggregation. The server decrypts and adds ciphertexts to perform secure aggregation.
pse.effect: The system ensures privacy of sensitive data while allowing collaboration in training large-scale machine learning models. It enables high-precision models in various fields such as traffic control, healthcare, industrial IoT, and cybersecurity.
